description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity class that sets up the main user interface, manages fragment transactions, and handles menu options for toggling logs visibility. It also initializes a logging chain for in-app logging display.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages the main screen, including fragment transactions and logging.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the activity layout and initializes the CardReaderFragment.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu items, toggling visibility and text based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, particularly toggling log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain for display within the app.
